professionalSummary.headline: Senior Staff Full-Stack & AI Systems Engineer with 10+ years of proven success
professionalSummary.tagline: Lead, sole or key developer on every project
professionalSummary.bio: Long-term core engineer and architect trusted by high-profile enterprise companies and scaling startups to lead critical system overhauls, compliance-driven deployments, and zero-to-one product development. Ingeniero en Sistemas, UNEFA, 2008 to 2014. Spanish and English native, Italian basic.
highlights: SecureBancard (critical project rescue): saved a high-stakes, time-sensitive launch by single-handedly engineering 80% of the Dual BIN support implementation, hitting strict compliance deadlines.
Engineering leader for the Clutch Prep B2B product, driving the technical milestones that led to the acquisition by Pearson.

InsurAdmin and Agency Rocket (InsureTech automation): developed InsurAdmin from scratch, a platform managing complex carrier feeds and agency teams. Engineered core automation parsers (Annuity, IUL, Whole Life) and fully integrated the Stripe billing engine for the Agency Rocket marketing suite (My New Retirement, Wealth United, etc.).
PMX Affiliate Marketplace: engineered, developed and launched the full-stack architecture of the affiliate marketplace, with a native integration into the Shopify ecosystem.
GRCTechMe, CTO: he got it onto the Google Cloud Marketplace, passing review on the first try with no fixes

Líder de ingeniería del producto B2B de Clutch Prep, impulsando los hitos técnicos que llevaron a la adquisición por Pearson.
